name: WINNER FinMind GET Diagnosis V2

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  diagnose:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Diagnose GET for one stock without exposing token
        env:
          FINMIND_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FINMIND_TOKEN }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import os, json, urllib.parse, urllib.request, urllib.error
          token = os.environ.get('FINMIND_TOKEN', '').strip()
          if not token:
              raise SystemExit('FAIL: FINMIND_TOKEN is missing')
          print('TOKEN_PRESENT: YES (hidden)', flush=True)
          params = {
              'dataset': 'TaiwanStockShareholding',
              'data_id': '7711',
              'start_date': '2026-11-02',
              'end_date': '2026-11-13',
              'token': token,
          }
          url = 'https://api.finmindtrade.com/api/v4/data?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
          req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0', 'Accept': 'application/json'}, method='GET')
          try:
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as response:
                  status, raw = response.status, response.read(8192)
          except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
              status, raw = exc.code, exc.read(8192)
          except Exception as exc:
              print('NETWORK_ERROR_TYPE:', type(exc).__name__)
              raise SystemExit(1)
          print('HTTP_METHOD: GET')
          print('HTTP_STATUS:', status)
          try:
              obj = json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
              if isinstance(obj, dict):
                  print('API_STATUS:', obj.get('status'))
                  msg = str(obj.get('msg', ''))
                  for secret in (token, urllib.parse.quote(token, safe='')):
                      if secret:
                          msg = msg.replace(secret, '[REDACTED]')
                  print('API_MSG:', msg[:500])
                  rows = obj.get('data')
                  print('DATA_ROWS:', len(rows) if isinstance(rows, list) else 'N/A')
              else:
                  print('RESPONSE_TYPE:', type(obj).__name__)
          except ValueError:
              print('RESPONSE: non-JSON (body hidden)')
          if status != 200:
              raise SystemExit('GET rejected; see sanitized status/message above')
          PY
